sources.title: GitHub - biomed-AI/DeltaCata: Predicting enzyme kinetic parameter ...
sources.snippet: DeltaCata is a siamese geometric graph neural network for direct predictions of enzyme kinetic parameter changes upon residue substitutions ( Δ $\mathrm{\Delta }$ kcat and Δ $\mathrm{\Delta }$ Km). DeltaCata is easy to install and run, and is also fast and accurate (surpassing state-of-the-art kinetic parameter predictors and general-purpose protein design models).
